[[Sulmeng's Staff]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Sulmeng the Skull Staff]] and [[Chae Plan]], [[boss]]es who can be found in [[Kinya Province]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +5
:[[Chaos damage]]: 7-11 (Requires 5 [[Illusion Magic]])
:Halves casting time of Illusion Magic [[spell]]s (Chance: 10%)
:Halves skill [[recharge]] of Illusion Magic spells (Chance: 10%)
:[[Armor rating|Armor]] +5 (vs. [[physical damage]])
:[[Energy]] +3

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Jeweled Staff]].

==Replica==
Except for the unusual single-attribute skill recharge mod, it is possible to create a [[perfect]] technical version of this item with:
*[[Jeweled Staff]] from collectors [[Cinder Linnwood]] or [[Merin Trollsbane]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Shelter]]
